name: shunt
description: A Claude Mod for the shunt gateway: a band above the prompt shows how much of each window is used and the time to reset — the shared account pool's, read from shunt's GET /usage, or the session's own Claude rate limits off shunt — and /shunt:usage prints the pool's full breakdown.

usageBand.title: Usage band
usageBand.description: Show usage above the prompt: the shunt pool's, refreshed every minute and after each turn, or the session's own rate limits off shunt. Off, the mod polls nothing and /shunt:usage still answers.
